scope: actual peer MCU allocation/free call paths
observations: AndesAllocCmdMsg reads ad->chipCap and ad->MCUCtrl before normal sender wrapper admission
Allocator increments alloc_cmd_msg and returns private message to command builder
AndesForceFreeCmdMsg and AndesFreeCmdMsg access ad->MCUCtrl after freeing message
Refused normal sender frees private message, which therefore still needs pinned adapter lifetime
consequence: Sender inflight zero does not prove absence of private builders or message destructors. Do not bind release solely to sender_drained/release_claim.
required_next_step: Cover allocation/build/destruction with an adapter-lifetime lease or independently prove all caller pins. Transfer message ownership explicitly through send and asynchronous queues; only final destruction releases message ownership. Keep invocation drain separate from outstanding-message drain.
